title: Convert units
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.geo.units.convert: To a smaller unit: multiply (there will be more of them). To a bigger unit: divide. 1 ft = 12 in, 1 yd = 3 ft, 1 hr = 60 min, 1 m = 100 cm, 1 km = 1000 m.
hints.geo.units.two-step: Go through the unit in between: yards → feet → inches. Multiply the two numbers, don't add them.
hints.geo.units: Smaller unit: multiply. Bigger unit: divide. Two steps if there's a unit in between.

misconceptionMessages.geo.units-wrong-way: Check the direction: going to a smaller unit gives MORE of them (multiply); going to a bigger unit gives fewer (divide).
misconceptionMessages.geo.units-wrong-factor: Customary units don't go by tens: 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 hour = 60 minutes, 1 pound = 16 ounces.
misconceptionMessages.geo.units-one-step: There's a unit in between: you've done one step. Keep going (yards → feet → inches).
misconceptionMessages.geo.units-added: Multiply the conversion numbers, don't add them: 1 yard = 3 × 12 = 36 inches.

sections.title: Convert units
sections.objective: Convert 5 feet to inches, or 180 minutes to hours.
explain: A conversion number tells how many small units make one big one: 1 foot = 12 inches.
Smaller units come in bigger numbers: 5 feet is 60 inches.
sections.key: To a smaller unit: multiply. To a bigger unit: divide. Use the right number: 12 in a foot, 60 in an hour, 100 cm in a meter.

sections.title: Two steps
sections.objective: Convert yards to inches, or hours to seconds.
explain: When there's a unit in between, convert to it first.
sections.key: Go through the unit in between, or multiply the two conversion numbers: 1 yard = 3 × 12 = 36 inches.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Smaller unit: multiply. Bigger unit: divide. Two steps when there's a unit in between.
